title: Chronostasis: Why Clocks Seem to Freeze
caption:
Ever glance at a clock and it looks FROZEN?
A bored student checks the classroom clock, swears the second hand has stalled, and a cartoon brain literally snips the blurred frames out of the film.
It's chronostasis: during each fast eye jump (saccade) your brain masks the motion blur and backfills the gap, so the first thing you see after looking feels stretched.
Be honest - have you ever caught the second hand frozen like this?
Save this for your next boring class and follow for more brain hacks.
